description: This file provides shared utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to consistent colors, tailored for dark-themed dashboards. It includes functions `colorFromString` which generates deterministic pastel colors from strings, and `getStatusColor` which maps known status strings to theme colors or falls back to `colorFromString`. It exports these functions for use across the project.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-ish HSL color based on an input string, ensuring distinct hues for different strings while maintaining appropriate saturation and lightness for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a theme-specific color (like primary, success, error) for known statuses; for unknown statuses, produces a deterministic HSL color.
